title: Bouncing Balls Cat Toy With Feather - Interactive Cat Bouncing Ball With Tail, Bouncing Cat Toy For Indoor Cats & Playful Kittens, Soft Colorful Feathers, 4 Count Pack
body_html:
• ENGAGING PLAYTIME FOR CATS – Spark your cat’s curiosity with the  Bouncing Balls Cat Toy! This interactive cat bouncing ball with tail and soft colorful feathers encourages chasing, pouncing, and batting for hours of indoor fun.
  • COMPLETE 4-COUNT PACK – Includes 4 bouncing balls for cats with tails and soft colorful feathers. Ideally sized for kittens and grown cats, these balls provide endless interactive fun, lightweight, durable, and easy to bat, chase, and swipe indoors.
  • PREMIUM PLAY MATERIALS – Made with durable rubber and soft colorful feather accents, these bouncing balls cat toys are designed for repeated play. The bouncing cat toy moves unpredictably, stimulating hunting instincts while being gentle on paws.
